lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item (titled FS 38) SOLD = $65 (Gowans, Mar 2026). 65 / 1.22 = 53.3, round down to $50. Caution: photo-matched same-class units made $30 (Oct 2025) and $60, so $50 is the top; $25-45 is a safer bid. Flip: likely resale $65 hammer at Gowans less about 15% vendor commission (assumed) = $55, no postage (local), 55 / 2.44 = 22.5, round down to $20. Barely worth flipping.

lots.condition: Used, fair cosmetics, running state unknown.

AAAC $25 (2022, page blocked by security page, outside 24 months). Antique Bazaar AU$395 (page 404, listing gone).
